description: Reruns of every thesis CV run (CUB exempt) that patience stopped with its last improvement before the 20th epoch after the warm-up (after the training start without warm-up); found by Thesis/review/patience_recovery_2026-10-19/finde_faelle.py. Rule: patience_delay_epochs 20 -- those 20 epochs consume no patience, selection still covers them, patience counts fresh after them. Each variant is the run's original resolved ablation variant (name: <original config>__<original variant>) plus its epoch cap, the normal patience (20, Semi-iNat 10) and the delay.
name: patience_delay_rerun_2026-10-19
